body.objective: How do production agent platforms authorize agents to act on behalf of users and organizations? Cover policy engines (Cedar, OPA, OpenFGA / Zanzibar-style ReBAC) applied to agents, scoped short-lived credentials, agent identity standards, and approval gates for irreversible actions. Rank first primary sources: official engineering blogs, documentation, conference talks, papers, standards drafts (IETF, OAuth, SPIFFE), and open-source code from the organisations building these platforms, then credible reporting. Pull out concrete mechanisms (token exchange, delegation, on-behalf-of flows), product and standard names, dates, measured latency or scale numbers, example policies, human-in-the-loop approval designs, and documented failure modes or security incidents.
